title.zh: Bitwise的NEAR现货ETF获得美国首例上市批准，预计9月29日前后开始交易
title.en: Bitwise's NEAR spot ETF wins first U.S. listing approval, trading seen around Sept. 29

current_state.zh: Bitwise 的 NEAR 现货 ETF 已获得美国上市批准并清除注册障碍，计划质押 NEAR 持仓，收取 0.75% 年管理费及质押奖励单独费用，交易预计于 9 月 29 日左右开始。
current_state.en: Bitwise's NEAR spot ETF has received U.S. listing approval and cleared registration hurdles, plans to stake its NEAR holdings with a 0.75% annual management fee plus a separate charge on staking rewards, with trading expected around September 29.
